projects.title: BizViz
projects.description: BizViz is a financial business visualization tool that gives small business owners insight into different ways to keep their business operating during difficult times like the COVID-19 global pandemic. Using Machine Learning and powerful stock forecasting models, BizViz is able to provide a detailed outlook on the performance of a business and give them options to diversify their spending to optimize operation costs. This project performed very well, earning a "Top-8 Best Projects" nomination out of 150+ project submissions at HackGT.

projects.title: MileSnap
projects.description: MileSnap is an application that allows the user to take a picture of any gas station pricing sign and receive the gas prices and their corresponding fuel types. In 36 hours, our team created a winning image-processing algorithm that allowed for high-accuracy data extraction. This app was built at HackGT6 and won the PDI Software challenge for "Best Machine Learning Algorithm for Monitoring Gas Prices".
